reader_summary.headline: Over 13 years after its founding.
reader_summary.overview: Over 13 years after its founding. But for all the hype (and all the legitimately great things Airbnb has accomplished). Even before COVID, Airbnb's once-exponential bookings growth had declined to linear levels while the company's costs continued to balloon at accelerating rates.

key_points.text: But for all the hype (and all the legitimately great things Airbnb has accomplished).
Are public investors smart to bet on a permanent shift in travel behavior coming out of the pandemic?
